verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is available mainly through an AI client. The official MCP server and the Claude Code/Cursor/Codex plugins hand an agent memory tools it can call on its own to save, search and update memories. Search itself accepts natural-language questions, and `add` takes raw conversation turns and extracts facts automatically. However, there is no first-party natural-language command interface for managing the product (accounts, configuration, deletion, webhooks); natural-language control depends on a third-party agent harness. Missing for 10: a native natural-language control surface beyond memory add/search, documentation of natural-language admin operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.
